selection.population: rated standard games with both players 600-1500
selection.rating_rule: both players share one canonical ChessGuru rating band
selection.evidence_rule: dense stored evals and at least two 50cp decisions

required_checks: the board and move support every sentence
the chapter explains why rather than announcing a verdict
the wording is understandable for a 600-1500 player
the lesson is memorable enough to assign
the selected chapters form a coherent whole-game walkthrough
no source-player identity or private diagnosis is visible

promotion_boundary.next_decision: freeze independent coach review, measure accepted chapter and whole-game rates, then lock personal-versus-community source mix
